records.title: Copper-64 Utilization for Tumor Evaluation in Cats - Feline Mammary Carcinoma
records.eligibilitySummary: Cats weighing at least 3.8 kg with non-ulcerated mammary mass measuring at least 1 cm and histologic or cytologic diagnosis of mammary carcinoma. Must be naive or have incompletely excised tumor, be a good surgical candidate, and have no metastatic disease or significant comorbidities.
records.eligibilityDetails: Cats weighing at least 3.8 kg; Presence of non-ulcerated mammary mass measuring at least 1 cm; Histologic or cytologic diagnosis of mammary carcinoma; Naive disease or incompletely excised tumor (previous surgery such as lumpectomy or unilateral chain mastectomy acceptable); Good surgical candidate (decided by surgical oncologist); Patient able to stay in radiation isolation without constant monitoring; No known metastatic disease; No significant comorbidities; No previous chemotherapy or radiation therapy; No need for daily drug administration.
records.classification_reason: Current primary Cu64 feline mammary tumor-imaging cohort ON HOLD; diagnostic-only, not thyroid NIS study.

records.title: Canine Hemangiosarcoma Clinical Trial (The Effect of an Investigative Agent on Progression of Residual Disease in Canine Hemangiosarcoma)
records.eligibilitySummary: Dogs over 10 kg (22 lbs) and older than 1 year with histopathologically confirmed hemangiosarcoma (visceral and/or cutaneous) with no concurrent kidney, liver, heart disease, or blood clotting problems.
records.eligibilityDetails: Eligible dogs will have undergone histopathologic evaluation of their tumor. Dogs should weigh more than 10 kg (22 lbs) to be eligible and be older than 1 year of age. Preoperative medical records, radiographs, ultrasounds, complete blood counts, serum chemistries and urinalyses required. Owner must sign informed consent form. Participating dogs must: have owner willing to comply with all study procedures and available for duration of study; have no concurrent kidney, liver or heart disease or blood clotting problems; have no heart-based tumors.
records.principalInvestigator: Dara L. Kraitchman, V.M.D., Ph.D., F.A.C.C.
records.classification_reason: Current official primary explicitly closed to new enrollment, despite secondary stale recruiting descriptor.
